decision: We will cache resolve_credential tiers 0-2 for 30s in-process, invalidated on every write path, never caching a failed read.
We will cache the configured monthly LLM budget for 30s per org while leaving the spend figure uncached, invalidated on the admin write.
We will fence TTLCache invalidation and IdleGate wakes with an epoch so an in-flight read never undoes them.
We will sample clean runs of sub-10-minute scheduler jobs to one ledger row per 5 minutes and advance the sample clock only after a successful write.
We will idle-gate the mailing loops with producer wakes and error backoff, skip unchanged Meta lead rows, and batch the clientes contact refresh with a write-time blank guard.
We will cache immutable published qualification versions and the newest-published pointer for 30s, never drafts, dropped on publish.
We will wire producer wakes and cache invalidations into the mailing services and key store, raise the catalog refresh to 600s, and cover each with call-count tests.
